desc: Parse N and S, compute M = max(S), and set convolution length L = smallest power of two > 2*M.
Build a 0/1 indicator array of length L with 1 at indices in S.
Compute the self-convolution of the indicator via NumPy rfft/irfft (primary); pure-Python NTT fallback retained for environments without numpy.
For each B in S accumulate conv[2*B]; answer = (sum - N) // 2, printed to stdout.
Verified against all three public samples (PASSED).
Reformulation and counting identity verified by hand (sum conv[2B] = 11, (11-5)//2 = 3 on sample 1).
Exactness argument: coefficients <= N <= 1e6, float64 FFT rounding safe; single NTT would also be exact mod 998244353.
